title: The alcove is an open walk-in pantry with the microwave on a 30 in shelf
summary: Open shelves on three sides cost about 300 USD and keep the alcove one step from the dishwasher and the dining table. The microwave on a 30 in shelf there is the only place the 5-year-old reaches without lifting hot food down. A door can be added later for about 1,000 USD if the shelves look untidy from the table.

rejected.why: 1,000 USD more, and a door swinging beside the dishwasher; nothing is lost by adding it later

returns_if.text: when the open shelves are seen from the dining table and bother you
